toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create complete self-contained HTML demo, inline CSS and JS only, Canvas 2D software rasterization (absolutely no WebGL or libraries). Polished dark navy scientific exhibit aesthetic with large central canvas, title GOURAUD / rotating light study, subtle grid background, cyan/coral accents, live FPS badge, explanatory short footer, accessible W wireframe and P pause buttons with aria-pressed and keyboard shortcuts. Responsive layout. Implement real realtime minimal 3D pipeline with 8 cube vertices +/-1, 6 outward wound quads (carefully correct normals), each split into two triangles. Use explicit X/Y/Z rotation matrices applied to vertices and smooth vertex normals (normalized original corner vectors); camera origin looking +Z, translate cube to z=5.5; perspective projection with inverted screen Y. Backface cull using cross product of transformed face edges dotted with vector from face to camera, positive means visible. Per-vertex Lambert lighting from moving point light position in view space, normalize vector from vertex to light, ambient plus max(dot(normal,lightDir),0), use tasteful cyan base material and warm light tint. Rasterize triangles into reusable ImageData with bounding-box barycentric pixel-center coverage, interpolate RGB perspective-correctly using reciprocal vertex Z, depth buffer reciprocal Z for visibility. Lighting evaluated only at vertices, never per pixel; per pixel only interpolated color. Render at capped internal resolution (e.g. max 720x540 adjusted to canvas CSS aspect ratio) for realtime CPU performance, use offscreen canvas putImageData and drawImage scaled onto visible 2D canvas. Clear transparent pixels each frame and compose atop drawn background. All buffers reused except on resize, limit triangle bounds, no per-pixel object allocations. Add comments explaining math and Gouraud vs flat/Phong shading. Wireframe toggle overlays edges of culled-visible triangles including diagonal edges using projected screen coords. Animated point light position and visible glowing light marker projected with same perspective. Pause freezes rotation AND light animation, requestAnimationFrame continues to display/measure actual FPS and allow toggles. Use frame delta capped after tab changes, FPS smoothed/update at ~0.4 second intervals, initialize animation correctly. Resize responsive with ResizeObserver/window resize, ensure no zero buffer sizes. Buttons clickable, ignore repeat shortcuts and ignore keys typed in form fields. Deliver fully working file, no external resources/fonts, no extra files."}
